connectorUiConfig.title: Dynatrace Runtime Vulnerabilities V3
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: This connector uses the [Dynatrace DQL Storage Query API](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language) to ingest detected runtime vulnerabilities into Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics.
connectorUiConfig.additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on a parser based on Kusto Function to work as expected which is deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution. It also requires the **Consolidate Dynatrace Runtime Vulnerabilities** summary rule to be enabled from the Content Hub.

sampleQueries.query:
DynatraceSecurityProblems
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where VulnerabilityType == "THIRD_PARTY"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where VulnerabilityType == "CODE_LEVEL"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISRiskLevel == "CRITICAL"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISRiskLevel == "HIGH"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISExposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISPublicExploit == "AVAILABLE"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Dynatrace SaaS environment (ex. xyz.apps.dynatrace.com)
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace SaaS environment (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com) with [Application Security](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/application-security/) enabled. Classic Dynatrace environments (xxx.live.dynatrace.com) are not supported.

customs.name: Dynatrace Platform Token
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:security.events:read*** scopes. See [Dynatrace platform tokens](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens) for instructions.

instructionSteps.title: Dynatrace Vulnerabilities Events to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Configure and Enable Dynatrace [Application Security](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/application-security/). 
 1. Create a platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:security.events:read*** scopes following [these instructions](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens). 
 2. Use your Dynatrace SaaS environment URL in the format ***xyz.apps.dynatrace.com***. 
 3. In **Microsoft Sentinel → Content Hub**, find the Dynatrace solution and enable the ***Consolidate Dynatrace Runtime Vulnerabilities*** summary rule. This is required to consolidate raw vulnerability events into the table used by analytics rules and the parser.
